c. 1948
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ASCETIC
"O Lord God and Sanctifier of Thy Saints!", Exclaims St. Augustine. "Thous art the eternal comfort of those who reject the comforts of the world for the love of Thy consolations. .... "When I meditate on this truth, O Lord my Comforter: my soul is willing to do without the consolations of this life in order to be worthy of Thy eternal consolations ."
PURPOSE OF THE RATIONAL CREATURE
TO KNOW GOD MY CREATOR is the purpose of my creation, the supreme end and aim of my existence as a rational creature.
This includes everything and gives a purpose to each and all sciences, human and divine.
God made me to know Him. Oh: What a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's Heaven-begun, for the grateful, on earth. -- To treasure aright! ? ! Highest Heaven its worth.
God Himself is the reward -- infinitely great -- both, here and hereafter of those who strive
(unfinished)
